args.question: Cobalt Labs has one approved invoice: INV-18773 for $12,507.54 (due 2026-11-04). This exceeds the $10,000 threshold, so it requires controller approval before payment. Do you approve sending a wire of $12,507.54 from the operating account to pay INV-18773 in full?
